description: The graph illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for different ensemble models, with the x-axis representing cost on a linear scale ranging from 30 to 8, and the y-axis showing reliability score on a linear scale from 50 to 90. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue line labeled "3-Model Ensemble" with circular markers, a red line labeled "2-Model Ensemble" with circular markers, and a yellow line with circular markers that does not have a label. The blue line starts at a reliability score of approximately 78 when the cost is 30 and increases to about 88 at a cost of 8. The red line begins at a reliability score of approximately 77 when the cost is 30 and rises to about 87 at a cost of 8. The yellow line starts at a reliability score of approximately 82 when the cost is 30 and decreases to about 65 at a cost of 8. All three lines show a general trend of increasing reliability score with increasing cost, except for the yellow line, which shows a decreasing trend.
